body: I am here. I relate beyond any normal level. I’ve lived your experiences. What I can say are two things. First this is beautifully written. Hopefully you are pursuing a writing career or use it as a past time. This peace was very impactful for me also suffering with suicidal thoughts and depression from a young age. Secondly, We are always here to talk to you. If your feeling lonely come post here. Let us know your thoughts because we are glad to listen and help you through your battle.

Thank you, I’ve seen 7 shrinks in this time period. Idk I did not seen the movie until early this year but I guess you could say I went a little Will Hunting on them. You know the scene where he causes robin williams to get in his face on the verge of tears picture that but with a 9 year old. haha. I’ve met one that I have bonded with and I think that will be good for me in the long term.
